name: Vistara action-aware egocentric summariser
framework: PyTorch 2.x + open_clip (ViT-B/32, OpenAI weights) + OpenCV Farneback optical flow

preprocessing.window_feature: [mean CLIP emb(512), last-first emb diff(512), 3 robust-normalised motion cues] = 1027 dims

action_head.trained_on: EPIC-KITCHENS-100 train split (videos not in the manifest)

label_head.arch: linear 512->16 initialised from CLIP text prompts, L2-regularised towards them
label_head.trained_on: FPVSum videos not in the manifest + EPIC clips as 'cooking'

highlights.selection: greedy MMR with redundancy + pair-novelty terms

inference: Python engine in Engine~ (FastAPI, port 8765) started by Unity BackendLauncher; Unity talks JSON over HTTP
onnx: not used: optical flow, video decoding and highlight rendering are not available in-engine; the original PyTorch weights are used unchanged
